subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled localhost provider-path evidence sufficient for this FAL security-boundary change, or must the PR show a live FAL or representative external proxy/TLS/private-endpoint request?
rationale: Source and test review support the implementation, but repository policy requires live verification for external API work and the contributor explicitly states that the relevant external transport path was not exercised.

options.title: Require external transport proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until current-head redacted output exercises live FAL or a representative external proxy, TLS, or private endpoint.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Accept the controlled provider-path output because the patch only connects FAL to an existing, focused-tested shared resolver contract.

recommendation.title: Require external transport proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until current-head redacted output exercises live FAL or a representative external proxy, TLS, or private endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the common FAL HTTP helper and recently maintained the shared request-policy resolver governing the changed boundary.
